- [stated] writing a long-form dark fantasy / gothic horror / Cthulhu-style novel in Chinese, planning several million characters in total [s:abedbb1f575fa5e9]
- [stated] protagonist 莫伊伦: cold, somewhat mad, white hair, works for 罪冠庭; subordinate 米洛 (21): admirer who wants 莫伊伦's approval and looks down on the weak while respecting the strong [s:abedbb1f575fa5e9]
- [stated] chapter 1 premise: 莫伊伦 investigates a monster attack at a town almshelter; the 白银城 saint and a letter addressed 哥哥 are open threads [s:abedbb1f575fa5e9]
- [stated] wants chapter 1 to emphasize monster horror and 莫伊伦's entrance; asked for gore and body horror one notch heavier than first draft [s:abedbb1f575fa5e9]
- [stated] novel is titled 魔女不会死; has subscribed to Pro and created a Claude project of that name for it (setting files and instructions still to be added) [s:abedbb1f575fa5e9]
- [stated] is organizing a setting document and earlier chapter summaries to share next [s:abedbb1f575fa5e9]
- [stated] plans to split work into a setting/summary resource plus a new conversation every few chapters [s:abedbb1f575fa5e9]
- [stated] on Claude Pro plan; uses Sonnet for day-to-day setting discussion and drafting, switches to Opus for high-stakes/critical scenes to conserve usage [s:abedbb1f575fa5e9]
- [stated] often revises settings and outline and keeps adding future plot ideas; does not want old setting files to stay the baseline [s:abedbb1f575fa5e9]
- [stated] has written 20 chapters but only a few plot ideas beyond them; considers some chapters weak and welcomes Claude's own ideas, discussion, and rewriting from scratch [s:abedbb1f575fa5e9]
- [stated] wants readers moved to tears, laughter, or gripping suspense [s:abedbb1f575fa5e9]
- [stated] tried the "webnovel-writer" Claude Code plugin (github.com/lingfengQAQ/webnovel-writer) but found its terminal-style interface lacking the conversational feel; decided to stick with chatting with Claude instead [s:abedbb1f575fa5e9]
- [stated] chose to keep novel files (setting docs, 20 chapters, archives) on their own Windows computer at Documents\魔女不会死\, so Claude can read/edit them directly via the device link instead of manually syncing a claude.ai project knowledge base [s:abedbb1f575fa5e9]
